newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent pulled to session lows by weak gasoline.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent pulled to session lows by weak gasoline.

text.p: IPE Brent futures lost ground on Monday as NYMEX gasoline led the market lower, brokers said.
April Brent crude oil traded down to a session low of $18.72 a barrel, before recovering slightly to trade three cents down at $18.82 at 1551 GMT.
"There's no news out there. (NYMEX) gasoline is seen as the support for the market so when that goes down the rest follows," one said.
April NYMEX unleaded gasoline last traded down 0.66 cents at 61.90 cents a gallon.

The market had been expected to correct upwards on Monday following Friday's substantial losses, but brokers were now looking for a further downward move with next support on the prompt Brent contract seen at $18.67 a barrel.
"There's been a treble bottom there and that should be quite good support. We are still looking for a correction but when it will happen is a bit of a lottery," another broker said.
March gas oil traded last down 25 cents a tonne at $162.25. The April Brent/gas oil crack had firmed from a low on Friday of $2.70 a barrel to around $3.00 on Monday afternoon.
